title: Hook list view: display, create, delete
description: Implement hook list view in app.js. Fetch and display all hooks, create new hooks, delete hooks with confirmation, copy ingestion URL to clipboard, navigate to hook detail.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches GET /api/hooks and renders list with name, ID, request count, ingestion URL
Create Hook button sends POST /api/hooks and refreshes list
Delete button per hook with confirmation dialog
Empty state message when no hooks exist
